items.q: the time that Sam Cooke was killed, I was--I just opened a tour with him

ctx.x: What you're looking at now, that's when maybe I kind of went on society type dates at home. I didn't travel. I'll show you the one I'm talking about.
What I meant is I was usually looked on as Ernie Fields and Son, but the time that Sam Cooke was killed, I was--I just opened a tour with him, and to show you how hard it is (inaudible).
